Restore the Elector Province of Drakwald

Around 1110 IC Count Vilner, the last Elector of Drakwald, fell, and no successor was ever chosen. Over the centuries that followed the Beastmen and the Goblins burned our towns, and by 1414 IC Middenland and Nordland had divided the province between them. If we hold the old lands of Drakwald again, we can raise its crown and claim its place among the Electors.

The duchies of old Drakwald return to the crown of Drakwald, which becomes your primary title unless you already hold a kingdom or an empire. The Runefang of Drakwald comes home, and the Electors of Middenland and Nordland will resent you.
Restore the Elector Province of Solland

In 1707 IC the Waaagh of Gorbad Ironclaw burned Solland, and at Solland's Crown the Warboss took the crown from the head of Elector Count Eldred. Wissenland took our lands while we were weak. If we take them back, we can show the Empire that Sollanders are not broken, and claim our place among the Electors again.

The duchies of old Solland return to the crown of Solland, which becomes your primary title unless you already hold a kingdom or an empire. The Runefang of Solland comes home, and the Elector of Wissenland will resent you.
